entities.summary: Huang Shaohong was a Chinese general and politician who governed Guangxi as part of the New Guangxi Clique through the latter part of the Warlord Era and a later a leader in the Nationalist government of the Republic of China. He later defected to the Chinese Communists during the Chinese Civil War, but suffered persecution during the Anti-Rightist Campaign and the Cultural Revolution. He committed suicide during the latter in 1966.
